integrity.basis: Complete analytic proof with finite exact-rational and optional numerical optimization cross-checks
integrity.historical_scope_note: Known four-index triangular boundary is excluded from the new claim.

limitations: Real unweighted Johnson graphs J(n,2) only, integer n at least five.
Exact projection norm constants are asserted only for endpoint exponents one and infinity; global minimality of the orthogonal projections covers all exponents one through infinity.
No uniqueness among all minimizing projections, no higher-rank Johnson graphs, and no complex or weighted variants are asserted.
Research-literature indexing can miss equivalent results in other formulations or sources; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Sharp cycle and cut projection norms for triangular Johnson graphs
